_comment: gentle-eye project-local tier ordering — CURATED 5-TIER LADDER (2026-05-28, user pick for the dayflow dogfood). Climb order: all-local → openai-artisan-local-critic → mixed-budget → mixed-mid → claude-code-handoff. Drops the redundant local-heavy variants (2,3), the gemini-lib tier (4, blocked anyway), the free groq/cerebras (5,6), the reasoning tier (10), and BOTH marker-gated frontier paid tiers (openai-heavy 11, openai-max 13). Net effect: local-first, then a short cheap-mixed escalation, then senior in-house handoff as the last mile — no frontier-paid spend reachable. Full 13-tier ladder preserved at ralph-tiers.full-13.bak.json. NOTE: this is the ma-loop FALLBACK ladder; in lite mode the in-session agent runs the [S] cargo-check checkpoints and only hands a stuck file to ma-loop.
